metrics.target_detection_definition: one target detection opportunity per visible truth period; hit if any production detection record matches that period's target
metrics.detection_record_definition: production detection_results rows matched against truth; not CFAR hit-cell count
metrics.cluster_false_alarm_definition: selected CFAR clusters minus one target-associated cluster per matched target period

valid_cut_denominators.definition: each recorded period/beam/branch has a positive valid CUT denominator; overlapping branch denominators are not summed

unique_final_union_hits.definition: positive CUT cells in the merged final CFAR hit map, in production period order; descriptive counts, not Pfa

cell_false_hit_fraction.definition: unique production detector CUT hits / unique valid CUTs

empirical_structured_clutter_false_hit_f.definition: unique production detector CUT hits / unique valid CUTs

false_clusters.definition: explicit false-cluster count in one target-off evaluation

protocol_false_detections.definition: all production OFF detection rows; no truth match is possible

false_tracks.definition: unique production debug track IDs with Confirmed/output evidence

layer_definitions.valid_cut_denominators: each recorded period/beam/branch has a positive valid CUT denominator; overlapping branch denominators are not summed
layer_definitions.unique_final_union_hits: positive CUT cells in the merged final CFAR hit map, in production period order; descriptive counts, not Pfa
layer_definitions.cell_false_hit_fraction: hit_cells / valid_cut_count when the denominator is exported
layer_definitions.false_clusters: explicit OFF CFAR cluster count or IDs
layer_definitions.false_tracks: unique production debug track IDs with Confirmed/output evidence
